content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

COREMERCH is a sovereign commerce infrastructure company that provides digital creators with a fully operational online store, complete with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means that creators can set up shop, sell their digital products, and collect payments without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe or PayPal. The result is greater control, flexibility, and revenue potential for digital creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack is built on a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments. This stack provides a secure, scalable, and customizable infrastructure for digital creators to sell their products and collect payments in cryptocurrency. By using these tools, creators can automate delivery, track orders, and manage customer data – all without relying on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip are unavailable or severely restricted. This includes countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, and Tanzania. By providing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, COREMERCH empowers creators in these regions to sell their digital products and grow their businesses – without relying on restricted platforms.
COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack is built on a combination of free and paid tools, providing a secure, scalable, and customizable infrastructure for digital creators.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack consists of several key components, including the Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, and Complete Builder Kit. The Sovereign Starter Stack provides a basic infrastructure for creators to set up shop and sell their products, while the Edge Commerce Stack offers advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. The Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, provides everything creators need to build, deploy, and scale their sovereign digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with COREMERCH, digital creators can purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, which includes deployment and setup services. Alternatively, creators can purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to build their sovereign digital commerce stack. By following the deployment checklist, creators can set up their infrastructure and start selling their digital products in cryptocurrency – without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
By using COREMERCH, creators can save money on transaction fees and retain more revenue from their digital product sales.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on selling digital products without platform fees, be sure to check out our Complete Builder Kit, which provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our solutions.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack with COREMERCH, follow these steps: purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, which includes deployment and setup services; or purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates; configure your NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrency payments; set up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting; and deploy your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack?

Integrating NOWPayments with your COREMERCH stack is straightforward. Simply configure your NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrency payments, and then link it to your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic. This will enable automatic crypto payment processing and ensure that your customers can pay for their digital products in cryptocurrency.
What are the fees associated with using COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack?

The fees associated with using COREMERCH's stack are minimal, with a 0.5% charge for all transactions. This is significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad. By using COREMERCH, creators can save money on transaction fees and retain more revenue from their digital product sales.
Can I use COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack in multiple countries?

Yes, COREMERCH's stack is designed to be globally accessible, allowing creators to sell their digital products in multiple countries without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe or PayPal. This makes it an ideal solution for creators who want to expand their business globally.
How do I automate delivery of my digital products with COREMERCH?

Automating delivery of digital products with COREMERCH is straightforward. Simply configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic to deliver your products automatically, and then trigger the delivery process when a customer makes a purchase. This will ensure that your customers receive their digital products instantly, without any manual intervention.
What are the benefits of using COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack?

The benefits of using COREMERCH's stack include greater control, flexibility, and revenue potential for digital creators. By providing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, COREMERCH empowers creators to collect payments in cryptocurrency, automate delivery, and manage customer data – all without relying on restricted platforms.
Can I customize my COREMERCH sovereign digital commerce stack?

Yes, COREMERCH's stack is highly customizable, allowing creators to tailor their infrastructure to their specific needs. By using the Complete Builder Kit, creators can customize their stack to include additional features and functionality – all without relying on third-party platforms.
